# PLANNED VS ACTUAL DELTA

## Reference-derived plan

Make dynamic people read like grounded sitcom actors: restrained but expressive faces, conversational eye lines, readable hands, directional shoes, believable torso masses, open-palm speech, crossed-arm skepticism, and pocket-hand observation. Preserve neutral identity apart from expression.

## Actual implementation

The human-canvas rig now consumes evaluated body, arm, gaze, blink, and hand-pose channels. Hands render open, relaxed, point, hold, and fist silhouettes. Shoes expose toe, heel, sole, and stance direction. Sustained contact poses bypass follow-through and body-emphasis overrides. Unscripted gestures correctly reach hold.

## Discovered defects resolved

1. `Number(null)` caused absent gesture progress to become explicit zero, trapping unscripted gestures in anticipation.
2. Gesture follow-through moved locked crossed and pocket arms.
3. Body finalization overwrote locked hands during speech emphasis.
4. Human-canvas joints ignored evaluated performance arms.
5. Human-canvas eyes used a separate gaze and blink clock.
6. Shoes lacked directional toe and heel structure.

## Open delta

None.
